title: La Bola Negra wins TIFF People's Choice Award
summary: The film, directed by Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi, is an epic that spans the interconnected lives of three gay men in Spain.

image.caption: Penelope Cruz attends the red carpet for La Bola Negra at the Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF) in Toronto on Sept. 15, 2026. (Mark Blinch/Reuters)
